text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We use her training plan for today's
session.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Every minute went exactly as I planned.
Thank
you for going along with it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I would liken this feeling to the first time
I baked
a cake using a recipe I created
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems this was a great experience for
Eishin
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the session doesn't go
according to
plan...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I knew this result was within
the realm
of possibility.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to following your
instruction again
for our next session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash never brings up the idea of
creating
her own training sessions again
after that.
